segments.name: Fiber optic management, protection, and delivery products
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and distributes fiber protection, management and delivery products for broadband service providers across North America and international markets.
segments.evidence: Clearfield is focused on providing fiber management, fiber protection, and fiber delivery products that accelerate the turn-up of fiber-based networks in residential homes, businesses, and network infrastructure in the wireline and wireless access network.

revenueModel.text: Broadband service providers pay Clearfield for fiber management, protection and delivery products, sold direct through its sales force and through authorized distributors and sales representatives.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's products are sold direct to customers through the Company's sales force as well as through authorized distributors.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold its Nestor Cables business, previously reported as the Nestor Cables Operating Segment, leaving one reportable segment.
changes.evidence: On November 11, 2025, the Company completed the sale of its Nestor Cables business, which was previously reported as the Nestor Cables Operating Segment.
